description: This file defines a class 'ClusterDiagnosticsService' which provides functionality to gather and process cluster diagnostic data, including grain call frequencies, host and grain details, and calling relationships within an Orleans-based distributed system.

classes.name: ClusterDiagnosticsService
classes.description: Main class that collects and processes diagnostics data across the Orleans cluster.

classes.name: CallGraph
classes.description: Data structure encapsulating the details of the call graph including grains, hosts, edges, and max values.

classes.name: HostNode
classes.description: Represents a host with its name and activation count.

classes.name: GraphNode
classes.description: Represents a node in the graph with name, key, host, and weight.

classes.name: Key
classes.description: A composite key representing source and target for edges.

classes.name: GraphEdge
classes.description: Represents an edge in the graph with source, target, and weight.

methods.name: GetGrainCallFrequencies
methods.description: Asynchronously builds and returns a call graph including grain and host details, edges, and maxima.

methods.name: ResetAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously resets the internal state and deactivates certain grains.

methods.name: GetGrainVertex
methods.description: Retrieves or assigns a vertex for a grain, returns grain details structure.

methods.name: GetHostVertex
methods.description: Retrieves or assigns a vertex key for a host (silo).

methods.name: UpdateEdge
methods.description: Updates the call count for an edge between two vertices.
